name: skill-forge
title: Skill Forge
summary: Create and refactor Agent Skills to production grade and validate them against the agentskills.io open specification.

use_when: The user asks to create, build, or scaffold an Agent Skill
The user asks to write, improve, refactor, audit, review, or fix a skill
The user asks to validate or package a skill directory containing SKILL.md
avoid_when: The task is general coding work unrelated to creating or maintaining a skill
